title: SubagentPage
description: What `GET /transcripts/:engine/:id/subagents/:toolUseId/messages` answers: a page of what a subagent said, from the tail (plan 28, B-12).

events.description: What the subagent said in this page, oldest first — the same frames as a page of its parent.

nextCursor.description: The message the earlier page of the subagent starts from; `null` once its first message is in.
